name: va_pumped_bass
description: Pumped bass: one saw an octave down, mono with a long glide between notes, thinned by a high-pass at 180 Hz, pumping on every beat like a side-chain keyed by a kick (MSEG 1, Duck shape locked to the beat, on the volume: down about 13 dB in 5 ms, held 70 ms, back up over the rest of the beat on an exponential curve); its demo is a two-bar riff at 130 bpm.
